request.story_prompt:
Maya is a young girl who enters a mysterious forest alone. Deep inside the forest, she discovers an old Game Machine near a huge tree.
Curious, Maya touches the machine.
Suddenly—
“GAME START!” 🎮
The forest gates close, and Maya becomes trapped inside the game.
🔴 Level 1 – Forest Run
Maya must run through the dark forest while a terrifying shadow chases her. She avoids dangerous obstacles and successfully completes Level 1.
🟠 Level 2 – Mystery House
Maya enters an abandoned house filled with mysterious puzzles. She must solve the puzzles and find the correct exit before the game resets.
Using her intelligence, Maya completes Level 2.
🟢 Level 3 – Final Choice
Maya reaches the final room. On a table, she finds two cards:
1️⃣ LOSE
2️⃣ WIN
A mysterious voice says:
“Choose only one card…”
Maya takes a deep breath and chooses the WIN card.
Suddenly—
💥 GAME COMPLETED! 💥
The door opens, and Maya escapes from the forest.
Outside, she discovers the game's grand prize: bags of money, gold, and treasure. 💰💎

panels.scene_description: Maya stands before an ancient, glowing arcade machine embedded in the roots of a massive, gnarled tree in the heart of a dark forest.

panels.title: Trapped in the Game
panels.scene_description: As Maya touches the screen, a pixelated 'GAME START!' text appears in the air, and heavy iron gates slam shut around the forest clearing.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, close-up of Maya touching an arcade screen, bright neon text 'GAME START!' floating in the air, heavy iron gate bars crashing down around the forest, vibrant glowing effects against dark forest background.

panels.title: The Shadow Chase
panels.scene_description: Maya sprints through the dense, dark woods, looking back in terror as a towering, amorphous shadow monster looms right behind her.
panels.image_prompt: Dynamic action shot, Maya running fast through a dark forest, a terrifying dark shadow monster with glowing eyes chasing her, motion blur, dramatic shadows, comic book panel, high intensity.

panels.title: The Final Decision
panels.scene_description: Inside a dim room, Maya stands before a table with two cards labeled 'LOSE' and 'WIN', her hand hovering over the 'WIN' card.
panels.image_prompt: Suspenseful interior scene, dim lighting, Maya standing at a wooden table, two glowing cards on the table, one says 'LOSE' the other 'WIN', Maya looking determined, cinematic comic book art, detailed facial expression.

panels.title: Victory and Treasure
panels.scene_description: The game ends with a burst of light, and Maya emerges from the forest to find piles of gold, jewels, and treasure chests scattered on the grass.
panels.image_prompt: Wide shot, Maya standing outside the forest edge, bright sunlight, piles of gold coins and sparkling treasure chests surrounding her, 'GAME COMPLETED!' text in a comic book bubble, joyful yet mysterious atmosphere.
